title: Scalar tensor comparison for independently prescribed tensor models
statement: On an essentially small ringed site J, let a:R→S be a map of commutative ring sheaves and let s be its prescribed normalized scalar-derived pair. For any independently prescribed closed derived tensor structures SR, SS and their K-flat total-tensor models TR, TS, there is a PairTensorComparison for s with these structures. It preserves K-flat complexes, has the scalar-unit pure-generator law on total complexes, and its derived comparison satisfies the representative square.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YY, 07A4 and 0941; representative tensor comparison and localization

proof.text: Use the normalized ordinary scalar tensor comparison and totalize its inverse on direct-sum summands. Naturality and the signed differential give a natural total chain isomorphism.

Scalar extension preserves K-flats. Resolve all homotopy objects by K-flats and use resolving-representative full faithfulness. Apply tensorComparisonDescent to the two prescribed models and the universal counit; its square is the normalization.

theorem coefficientPrescribedPairTensorComparison
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C]
    [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})]
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r}} (a : R ⟶ S)
    [∀ R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (scalarModules J R)]
    (s : ScalarDerivedPair a)
    (SR : CoefficientClosedStructure (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R))
    (SS : CoefficientClosedStructure (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J S))
    (TR : CoefficientTensorModels.{r, c, v, w} J R SR)
    (TS : CoefficientTensorModels.{r, c, v, w} J S SS) :
    Nonempty (PairTensorComparison.{c, v, r, w} a s SR SS TR TS)
